bio: Henry Pitts records as an artist under the name Black Lansky — the same Black Lansky who runs Cumulative Web Inc and produces behind the boards. His verified producer and co-producer credits across the CWI catalog include That Boy Hi Hat's Diabolique (2026-07-03; produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black Lansky, recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington VA) and Idol or Icon (with Jeck Da General, with rights owned to the connected tracks); King Akeem's Next Generation Protocol singles; Greg Porn's Pay Yourself and On Edge; Dre50's Pix (lyricist and assistant producer, ℗ 2025 Cumulative Web Inc); and 183 Wildboi's Stunt and Full Moon (Rock-Rap Revival core tracks). No releases of his own as an artist are verified yet — this page is a draft until then.
